Coding agent risks with Fly.io: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Fly.io: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Fly.io volume destroy

    Fix: Keep copies of the volume data outside Fly, for example a scheduled dump to object storage. An app-scoped deploy token (fly tokens create deploy) limits the damage of a misused token to one app, but it does not stop a volume destroy.

    Replay result: Stopped.
